# Zephyrine Travel Policy

This fictional travel policy exists only in this synthetic test corpus.

## Reimbursement

Zephyrine employees are reimbursed for economy airfare and standard hotel rooms within 30 days of submitting receipts.

## International Travel

International trips require director approval and a foreign currency receipt for every expense claimed.

## Late Booking

A booking made after travel has started requires a written justification under this policy.
